description: Two-panel comic-style meme about the 2016 tarmac meeting and the Clinton email investigation. Top panel: photos of Bill Clinton and Loretta Lynch with invented speech bubbles in which Clinton offers Lynch a Supreme Court seat to get Hillary Clinton 'off the hook' for the email matter. Bottom panel, captioned 'DAYS LATER...', shows FBI Director James Comey at his July 2016 press conference with FBI flags and a chyron reading 'Hillary Clinton Email Investigation', quoting his 'no reasonable prosecutor' line. The dialogue in the top panel is fabricated satire, not a real quote.
text: Hey Loretta! If you can get my wife off the hook for that e-mail thing, there’s a Supreme Court seat in it for you. ...and what if she loses?. Lose? Are you kidding? We own the media! How could she lose?. DAYS LATER.... ...our judgment is that no reasonable prosecutor would bring such a case. HILLARY CLINTON EMAIL INVESTIGATION. JAMES COMEY. FBI Director
flags: Top-panel dialogue is invented/satirical; no such exchange is documented
Meme implies a quid pro quo at the tarmac meeting, an unverified claim; Comey quote is real but recontextualized

The chyron reads 'Quite the meeting on the tarmac' with a ticker about an unrelated Mesa police story. The setting is consistent with Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport, where the meeting occurred.
